title: Nested vector range assignment
summary: Recovered VA 0x43e7d0: forward assignment over a half-open source range of 12-byte three-pointer vector records, invoking the existing vector assignment member once per record and returning the advanced destination. Direct original instructions and callers at 0x43e52b and 0x43e58e establish ECX/EDX source bounds, caller-cleaned stack destination, equality termination and sequential alias behavior. Vector assignment remains an explicit external member dependency, supplied by the original in tests.
test_description: GCC i386 direct differential tests against both accepted routines at their original addresses. A test-only regparm(3) declaration supplies unused EAX, end EDX, begin ECX and caller-cleaned destination stack argument. Tests cover null empty range, counts zero through eight for nonempty self-assignment, and all bounded source/destination/count combinations within eight records with empty sources, including both directions of record overlap. Assert return pointers, expected logical lengths, preserved begin/capacity fields, all backing words, outside records and enclosing canaries. Explicit FS installation must succeed; FS head checked after original and recovered calls. Local freestanding linked executable exits zero.
known_limits: Vector allocation, deallocation and nonempty distinct-vector copying remain the accepted assignment helper's responsibility; CRT-dependent paths and allocation failure are not exercised.
The portable implementation exposes ordinary pointer arguments instead of the original custom register ABI; its dependency member must be supplied by port integration.
Malformed or unreachable end pointers, invalid storage and throwing paths are outside the valid range contract; no validation or exception behavior is invented.
Native port pointer width changes record stride to three native pointers; the original i386 layout is 12 bytes.
No matching-byte or whole-game recovery claim.
